results.name: D1 docx → Markdown: every convertible corpus docx agrees with mammoth on all 7 axes
M1 Markdown → docx: every corpus Markdown file agrees with markdown-it-py on all 7 axes and python-docx opens every output
M2 every Markdown → docx output of the corpus is ECMA-376 schema-valid (transitional XSDs via lxml; a new package has no inherited errors, so 0 are allowed)
K1 pptx → outline: every corpus deck agrees with python-pptx slide by slide
X1/X2 xlsx → CSV vs openpyxl on Excel's cached values (allowlist with evidence) and the CSV round trip
U1 CSV: quoting, CRLF, BOM, used range, displayed text, delimiter sniffing, Excel typing, formula guard
U2 Excel semantics: ROUND decimal, A-family text, XLOOKUP modes, CSE shaping, text truncation, negative dates, SUMPRODUCT errors
U3 SUBTOTAL/AGGREGATE: 1–11 skip filtered rows, 101–111 skip all hidden rows, AGGREGATE options, hidden columns never skipped, nested subtotals, all excluded
U4 hide/AutoFilter model: unhide keeps filter rows, criteria case-insensitive, blanks, value list, foreign criteria not re-applied, off shows all
U5 new-package .xlsx keeps hidden rows / columns and the AutoFilter — re-read by us and by openpyxl
U6 in-place save keeps Excel's table-filter rows and SUBTOTALs, writes hide / unhide / AutoFilter so openpyxl sees them
U7 JSON persistence: hidden rows (manual/filter), hidden columns, AutoFilter, cached external links; hostile JSON sanitised
U8 insert/delete rows and columns shift hidden state and the AutoFilter; deleting the whole range removes it
U9 keyboard stepping skips hidden rows/columns; convert refuses unsupported pairs; loss lists are surfaced
N1 CSV formula injection (= + - @ tab-prefixed) is imported as text, never a formula
N2 unterminated quote does not hang or throw and keeps the rest of the text
N3 CSV cell cap: a huge CSV is refused/truncated with a loss note instead of exhausting memory
N4 NUL / lone surrogate / BOM-in-the-middle bytes survive CSV import as text
N5 mixed / bare-CR line endings parse as rows
N6 Markdown javascript:/data: links are not written as hyperlinks
N7 raw HTML in Markdown is not executed or embedded; it is counted as a loss
N8 deeply nested Markdown lists / quotes do not overflow the stack
N9 convert refuses a non-zip .docx and an empty .xlsx with an error (no crash, no partial output)
N10 AutoFilter XML with a bogus ref / non-integer colId / entity tricks is rejected or neutralised
N11 hostile workbook JSON (prototype keys, 1e12 row numbers, wrong types) cannot pollute or blow up
N12 SUBTOTAL with a bad function number / non-ref argument is an error, not a crash
N13 setFilterColumn outside the filter range throws; hiding beyond the sheet is clamped
N14 CSV export of text that looks like a number / formula / has leading zeros is quoted or reported as a loss
N15 pathological numbers: ROUND of 1e308 / NaN-producing input / negative digits beyond range stay finite or #NUM!
N16 XLOOKUP with mismatched shapes / bad modes is #VALUE!
N17 AutoFilter XML written with single quotes, spaces around = and a namespace prefix reads the same (found by tt72-office S1)
N18 hyperlink relationship targets: characters a URI forbids are percent-encoded, existing %XX kept, a stray % escaped, a colon in the first relative segment gets ./ (found by M2)
